attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Delaware state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in DE (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "DE" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets DE economic nexus threshold ($100,000 or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "DE" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_description: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
// No nexus - no filing required; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Delaware state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Delaware state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_description: // Calculate Delaware state additions and subtractions; set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0;
// No nexus - no adjustments; set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Delaware state corporate income tax. Applies 8.8% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_description: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Delaware tax at 8.8% flat rate
action_details.action_description: // Delaware uses 8.8% flat rate; set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits - 0.0 f> { apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits - } { 0.0 } ifelse cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax - cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_description: // No Delaware nexus - no tax liability; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_description: // No Delaware taxable income - no tax liability; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
